checks.name: named_context_and_delta_from_main
checks.result: Read the retained actual work branch from main at its original fork revision, with identical refreshed source versions to main and a stable repeated context hash. The explicit branch session was selected, not the main session. Branch metadata/Git receipt matched; delta runtime events were restricted to the requested branch.
criteria: 上下文结合 main 当前有效状态与本分支 fork 后增量。
其他分支运行事件不会混入；分支及来源版本进入 hash 和完整性字段。

checks.name: read_preserves_ownership_and_sources
checks.result: Named context/delta reads did not change project revision, current main selection, either session/claim records or source ledger bytes.

limitations: Developer self-use performed by the implementation agent, not independent business acceptance or E4.
